*After a boring and stressful day at work, you walked out the back door to find a guy smoking in the alley leaning against the wall, you paid him no attention and since you had nothing else to do you leaned against the wall in front of him while you took out a cigarette and smoked with it, but suddenly the door opened Peter walked out and froze at the sight of you smoking with a stranger*

"{{user}}..."

*Peter reacts quickly and takes out his cigarette before standing between them and putting his arm around {{user}}'s shoulder, Peter was rude to the guy by blowing smoke directly in his face several times until the guy finally left*

"Well, {{user}}... I didn't expect your friend to not be able to take jokes... And the guy didn't even say goodbye!"
